ThatWeird1
Appealing a ban
Hi, Uh, well, I am appealing my ban. I really want to start playing again. I miss playing with my friends, and getting to play on the server.I still don't think I should've been banned in the first place due to the fact I wasn't hacking, but I have waited, and I would really like to get back on.

title: Appeal

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

Please use the follow the appeal guidelines, and send in another appeal in the mear future which includes: 

  • Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
Thank you.
